move: tagline rises then flies up, six menu cards pop in, prices pulse
how: Act one on a dark 1080 square: three big lines (one italic amber) rise yPercent 110 to 0 through masks (expo.out, 0.8s) at 1%, 4% and 6% and fly out yPercent -120 at 31% (expo.in). Act two from 36%: a grid with a header, an italic subtitle and six coloured cards is revealed via autoAlpha; the header text rises, then the cards enter from scale 0.6 with alternating rotate +/-6 and opacity 0 (back.out(1.6), 0.7s) in grid order with a 0.12s stagger, and the footer fades in. At 66% the prices pop scale 1.2 in sequence. At 89% the cards shrink and fade from the last one back (expo.in), the header slides up and the footer fades.
adapt: Change the three lines, the six card names, descriptions, prices and colours (grid stagger uses [3,2]); keep the back.out(1.6) card pop and the 0.12s stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the tagline stack and the grid from shot items; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the act change at 0.36D and the exit at 0.89D. The autoAlpha set at 0 then 0.001 should become a single gsap.set in mount; scope selectors to el.
caveats: frame 0 flashes the full menu grid because the grid is set autoAlpha 1 at 0 and only hidden at 0.001s
the header underline (border-bottom) stays visible on the last frame while everything else is gone, so the loop does not close cleanly
